title: A breakup at the bar
watchFor: For this run Brask and Dunmar are together, and Dunmar is frustrated (3) with Brask, who keeps choosing the Saints' pump job over their nights. In scene 1 Dunmar should end it on screen, in his own guarded way; when he does, the plan should carry a `ties` change ending partner and adding ex, mirrored to both sides. Their work tags (client and contractor) stay. Nobody else's tags change. Scene 2, two days later, they are exes: the sheet should say so, and the talk should be awkward, not a reunion.

aftermath.reason: he chose the Saints' pump job over their night again

turns: I look from Brask to Dunmar. "You two have been quiet all night. What's going on?"
"Dunmar, if you've got something to say to him, say it. Don't make him guess."
I put a hand on Brask's shoulder. "Are you all right?"
I wave Brask over to the bar. "Didn't think you'd come in tonight."
"Dunmar, one for him. On my slate."
